description: City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data) is an open data portal listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by BA Data. BA Data is the City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data). This search read 450 of its catalogue entries in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, communications or other infrastructure asset, network or facility, or a natural hazard, are catalogued as records of their own ... Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires, Argentina. 450 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 20 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country or region. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
